description: This class includes the casting of non-ferrous metals and alloys.
includes: casting of light metals: aluminium, magnesium
casting of heavy metals: copper, zinc, lead, tin
casting of precious metals: gold, silver, platinum group metals
casting of semi-finished products of non-ferrous metals
excludes: manufacture of basic precious and other non-ferrous metals, see 2420
casting of iron and steel, see 2431
